name: Certified Transcript of Payroll - Report 8 - Race and Journey-Apprentice
license: Open Data Commons Open Database License

columns.name: Year
columns.description: The calendar year during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Quarter
columns.description: The quarter of the reporting year (Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4) during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Project County
columns.description: The Illinois county where the public works project is located. Used to identify regional trends in prevailing wage activity.

columns.name: Project Number
columns.description: The project name or number as reported by the contractor. This number is used for tracking and referencing project-specific wage and employment data.

columns.name: Company Name
columns.description: The name of the contractor reporting prevailing wage information for the project.

columns.name: Journey worker / Apprentice
columns.description: Classification of apprentice (workers undergoing structured training in a skilled trade), journeyworker (fully qualified skilled tradespeople who have completed apprenticeships), or neither apprentice or journeyworker.

columns.name: Percent White
columns.description: Percentage of apprentices, journeyworkers, or neither classification who are White.

columns.name: Percent Black or African American
columns.description: Percentage of apprentices, journeyworkers, or neither classification who are Black or African American.

columns.name: Percent Hispanic or Latino/a/ex
columns.description: Percentage of apprentices, journeyworkers, or neither classification who are Hispanic or Latino/a/ex.

columns.name: Percent Asian
columns.description: Percentage of apprentices, journeyworkers, or neither classification who are Asian.

columns.name: Percent American Indian or Alaska Native
columns.description: Percentage of apprentices, journeyworkers, or neither classification who are American Indian or Alaska Native.

columns.name: Percent Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
columns.description: Percentage of apprentices, journeyworkers, or neither classification who are Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander.

columns.name: Percent Other Race
columns.description: Percentage of apprentices, journeyworkers, or neither classification who are a race not specified.

columns.name: Total Hours
columns.description: The total number of hours worked under the specified trade for the contractor on the project during the quarter.
